{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Filter to completed orders only, excluding QA orders
df_completed_clean = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates_clean = df_completed_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum']).reset_index()
conversion_rates_clean['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates_clean['sum'] / conversion_rates_clean['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates_clean = conversion_rates_clean.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Extract the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment_clean = conversion_rates_clean.iloc[0]['customer_segment']

# Print the full cleaned table for evidence
print(conversion_rates_clean)

# Return the segment name
highest_segment_clean"}
